title: PTC-Bias：语音大模型中的音素级时间竞争偏置检索与解码后校正
summary: 提出PTC-Bias两阶段框架，利用音素级时间竞争实现高效上下文偏置。预填充阶段进行帧同步音素解码与候选竞争，生成紧凑偏置词短列表；解码后阶段在对应语音区间内进行局部竞争校正，减少近音词和分词错误。无需额外前向传播，在LibriSpeech上B-WER相对降低23.4%/23.9%。
summary_en: PTC-Bias is a two-stage framework using phoneme-level temporal competition for contextual biasing in SpeechLLMs. PTC Retrieval performs frame-synchronous phoneme decoding to produce a compact bias-word shortlist and speech intervals; PTC Correction then locally competes retrieved candidates against mismatched spans. Sharing phoneme posteriors with no extra forward pass, it cuts B-WER by 23.4%/23.9% on LibriSpeech with 2000 bias words.
